'''Lessu City''' was one of the two [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and endpoint of the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]].

==History==
[[Ro Fenn]]'s estate and the seat of the [[Twi'lek Ruling Council]] were located there. Like most cities on Ryloth, Lessu was located in the relatively narrow band of habitable land on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], commanded by [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], took control of the planet and took the Twi'leks [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] installed a [[Plasma bridge/Legends|plasma bridge]], which they could turn on or shut down, as the only way to get into the [[City/Legends|city]].

The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|later freed]] by the combined forces of [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], guided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and rebel leader [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]], with aerial support from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Anakin Skywalker erroneously called the city "Lessau" in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''.
